title: 第九章 天雨虽宽
slug: 剑来全本免费-剑来最新章节列表
content_zh:
女子左顾右盼，满是好奇，甚至伸手去触摸黄泥墙壁，实在察觉不出蛛丝马迹，好奇问道：“苻南华，这里真是你说的隐蔽福地之一？为何我家老祖之前给出的堪舆形势图上，对这条巷弄并未着重标注？”
年轻男人答非所问：“若是你我真在此地得了意外之喜，如何报答我？”
女子侧过身，双手十指交错放在身后，衬托得她胸口风光，愈发饱满丰硕，她半真半假柔声笑道：“任君采撷，如何？”
年轻男人不曾想她如此直白，反倒是没了章法，何况来此“访亲寻友”，担负着整个家族百年兴衰、甚至是千年昌盛的重任，他再花花心肠，也绝不敢在“众目睽睽之下”的小镇，与眼前女子来一场露水鸳鸯姻缘。
所以他很快转移话题，用手指向小巷深处，笑道：“蔡仙子，朋友归朋友，生意归生意，我不得不再重复一遍，按照之前的约定，这条泥瓶巷有两户人家，一对主仆，一对母子，我可以由你先任选其一，押注的本钱，便是你们云霞山的特产云根石，每年送给我们老龙城十块。”
女子点头，笑意妩媚，“当然可以呀。”
年轻男人缓缓前行，继续说道：“接下来，你一旦在此获得家族预期之外的机缘，那件物品必须交由你我双方祖师鉴定，给出一个公道价格，之后你们云霞山拿出一半的等价云根石，蔡金简，你可有异议？或者说，你能否确定，你在此时此地答应此事后，能够在利益得手、落袋为安了的事后，也能够说服你们云霞山的那几位祖师爷们，点头认可这项赌约？”
女子已经变了脸色，肃穆端庄，与先前判若两人，像是沦落风尘的青楼花魁，摇身一变，成了母仪天下的皇后娘娘，这位被称为云霞山蔡金简的女子，沉斩钉截铁道：“可以！”
年轻男人眯起眼，脸色晦暗，停下脚步，正视身高不输自己的女子，“丑话说在前头，你我今日能够结盟，互利互惠，可不是你我二人如何一见钟情，意气相投，只是老龙城与云霞山数百年来，历代祖师长辈们辛苦积攒下来的香火情，万一我们搞砸了，惹来那帮老头子们的雷霆震怒，别说我苻南华，或是你蔡金简，就算是我们的父母师父，也一样担待不起！”
蔡金简笑道：“所以在小镇这段时日，我们一定要坦诚相见，精诚合作，对吧？”
苻南华在这条阴暗巷弄，也尽显英俊风流，笑道：“除此之外……”
苻南华转头看了一眼，收回视线后，压低嗓音道：“咱俩还需小心那两人才是，毕竟他们不是正阳山，称不上是有口皆碑的名门正派，而且听说那两个家伙，本来就路子极野，不太讲规矩。”
高挑女子眯起那双会说话的丹凤眸子，像是在娇滴滴说着，所以我蔡金简才会选中你苻大公子嘛。
苻南华轻声道：“走吧，虽说此地有圣贤镇压、平衡各方势力，但是还是小心为妙，阴沟里翻船就不好了。总之，你我能否鲤鱼跳龙门，在此一举。”
这位名动一方的天之骄子，道心愈发坚定，在心中默念道：“大道可期，阻我前路，仙佛可杀！”
他望向小巷深处，看到一位清瘦少年从遥遥对面走来。
是第二次见面了。
两人继续悠悠然前行，如同一对落在凡间的神仙眷侣。
高挑女子也看到了那位少年，打趣道：“门那边，小巷里，两次碰着了，你说这个少年会不会？”
她话只说了一半，苻南华当然知道她的言下之意，哭笑不得道：“我的蔡大仙子，小镇六百户人家，加上十姓大族豢养的奴婢杂役，将近五千人，小镇再藏龙卧虎，也有个定数，何况这么多年来，那些个有根骨有福运有渊源的好胚子，早就给暗中瓜分殆尽了，我们这次之所以能够‘捡漏’，无非是那些心思难料的大神通人物，在故意卖漏而已。”

content_en:
The woman looked around, full of curiosity, and even reached out to touch the yellow mud wall. She couldn't find any clues. She asked curiously: "Fu Nanhua, is this really one of the hidden blessed places you said? Why was this alley not highlighted on the Kanyu situation map given by my ancestor?"
The young man answered the question inappropriately: "If you and I really get an unexpected surprise here, how will you repay me?"
The woman turned sideways and intertwined her hands and fingers behind her, making her chest look fuller and fuller. She smiled softly, half-seriously and half-falsely: "How about you pick it up?"
The young man never expected her to be so straightforward. On the contrary, she had no rules. What's more, coming here to "visit relatives and find friends" would bear the important responsibility of the whole family's rise and fall for a hundred years, or even a thousand years of prosperity. No matter how flirtatious he was, he would never dare to have a romantic marriage with the woman in front of him in a small town "in full view of the public."
So he quickly changed the subject, pointed to the depths of the alley, and said with a smile: "Fairy Cai, friends are friends, and business is business. I have to repeat it again. According to the previous agreement, there are two families in this Clay Vase Lane, a pair of masters and servants, and a pair of mother and son. I can let you choose one of them first. The capital of the bet is your Yunxia Mountain specialty Yungen Stone, which will be given to us, Old Dragon City, for ten yuan every year."
The woman nodded with a charming smile, "Of course you can."
The young man walked forward slowly and continued: "Next, once you get an opportunity here that the family did not expect, the item must be appraised by the ancestors of you and me, and a fair price will be given. After that, you, Yunxia Mountain, will give you half of the equivalent Yungen Stone. , Cai Jinjian, do you have any objections? Or are you sure that after you agree to this here and now, you can convince the ancestors of you Yunxia Mountain to approve this bet after the benefits are secured?"
The woman's face has changed, she is solemn and dignified, she is completely different from before, like a brothel courtesan who has fallen into the dust of the world, suddenly transformed into the empress of the world. This woman known as Cai Jinjian of Yunxia Mountain, Shen said categorically: "Yes!"
The young man narrowed his eyes, with a gloomy expression on his face, stopped, and looked at the woman who was as tall as him, "The ugly words are ahead, you and I can form an alliance today for mutual benefit, not because you and I fell in love at first sight, but we are like each other, it's just that Old Longcheng and Yunxia For hundreds of years, the ancestors and elders of the mountain have worked hard to accumulate the incense and love. If we mess up and provoke the thunderous wrath of those old men, let alone me, Fu Nanhua, or you, Cai Jinjian, even our parents and masters will not be able to bear it!"
Cai Jinjian smiled and said: "So during this time in the small town, we must be honest with each other and cooperate sincerely, right?"
Fu Nanhua also looked handsome and charming in this dark alley, and said with a smile: "Besides..."
Fu Nanhua turned his head and glanced, withdrew his gaze, and lowered his voice and said: "We still need to be careful about those two people. After all, they are not Zhengyang Mountain, and they cannot be said to be well-known and upright people. Moreover, I heard that those two guys have extremely wild ways and do not follow the rules."
The tall woman narrowed her talkative eyes and said sweetly, "That's why I, Cai Jinjian, chose you, Mr. Fu."
Fu Nanhua said softly: "Let's go. Although there are sages here to suppress and balance the forces of all parties, it is better to be careful. It will not be good if the boat capsizes in the gutter. In short, whether you and I can leap over the dragon's gate, we can do it in one fell swoop."
This proud man of heaven, who is famous all over the world, has become more and more determined in his Taoism, and silently said in his heart: "The great road can be expected, but if I block my way forward, the immortals and Buddhas can be killed!"
He looked deep into the alley and saw a thin young man walking from the opposite side.
It was the second time we met.
The two of them continued to move forward leisurely, like a couple of immortals falling into the mortal world.
The tall woman also saw the young man and joked: "Then thatWe bumped into each other twice in the alley. Do you think this boy can do it? "
She only said half of what she said. Of course Fu Nanhua knew what she meant, and he couldn't laugh or cry: "My Fairy Cai, there are six hundred households in the town, plus the slaves and servants maintained by the ten rich families, there are nearly five thousand people. No matter how hidden dragons and tigers are hidden in the town, there is still a certain limit. Count, not to mention that over the years, those good embryos with good foundation, good luck and connections have long been secretly divided up. The reason why we were able to "pick up the leaks" this time is nothing more than those people with great supernatural powers who have unpredictable minds and deliberately betrayed them. "
